notes: Governing document: the Faculty Handbook (Academic Year 2017-2018) ch. 3 Part One II.E Faculty Paid Parental Leave Policy (BOT 1/15/13) and II.F Modified Workload Policy; II.B.2 says leaves are granted under the HR Family and Medical Leave Policy and Other Leaves Policy, which the HR pages supply (IV-8 effective 1/1/2014; IV-11 effective 1/1/2008). All are in force on 2018-02-22. The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply: the handbook is a governing faculty leave document.

Birth parent chain: Faculty Paid Parental Leave as primary caregiver 16 weeks at 100% (c1), with FMLA 12 weeks running concurrently from the start (c3, exhausted first) → non-FMLA medical leave up to 12 weeks, discretionary, after FMLA is exhausted (c4), within the 26-week FMLA plus non-FMLA limit. Sick-pay schedule (c5) is pay within FMLA only (generic). If designated secondary caregiver instead: 3 weeks (c2, in lieu of c1) with FMLA concurrent.

Non-birth parent chain: Faculty Paid Parental Leave 16 weeks as primary caregiver (c1; caregiver conditions are gender-neutral, R6) or 3 weeks as secondary caregiver (c2, in lieu), with FMLA 12 concurrent (c3) → non-FMLA leave for a family member's serious health condition after FMLA (c4), discretionary; up to 12 sick days as pay during FMLA family medical leave (c7, within c3).

Whom the figures describe (U8): a two-year member meets the PPL's FMLA eligibility (12 months, 1,250 hours). Faculty not eligible for FMLA may apply to the Provost for an exception (PPL i.b: 'CWRU will seek to make appropriate leave accommodations') — a path for the non-eligible, recorded here only.

Dual-career limits: both parents on faculty, 19 weeks together (16 + 3); if the primary caregiver is not the birth mother, the primary caregiver's leave may be reduced by FMLA leave the birth mother took (c1 dual_employee_rule). FMLA: spouses limited to 12 weeks combined (c3).

Benefit categories: IV-9 (Sick Days, Categories 0,1), IV-13 (Adoption Leave, Category 0 only) and IV-8's short-term disability (Categories 2 and 3) depend on benefit categories defined in 'Introduction to Compensation and Benefits', which is not saved. Which category tenure-stream faculty hold cannot be determined from the saved documents, so c8, c10 and c18 carry the category name as faculty_group. The handbook's II.B.3 compensation schedule for illness leaves matches IV-9's schedule and is coded for faculty (c5).

Documents cited but not saved: HR Paid Parental Leave Policy IV-14 (paid parenting allowances for Category 1-3 employees); Sick Days (Benefit Categories 2,3) Policy IV-10; Introduction to Compensation and Benefits; Other Leaves of Absence Procedure IV-11a; Vacation Days Policy IV-6; Workers' Compensation I-6/6a; the 2017 Benelect Guide; constituent-faculty by-laws.

Not components: sabbatical leave (professional development); convenience leave (initiated by the university to reduce staffing); jury duty; military leave; administrative leave; additional leave for a documented disability via the disability accommodation process (IV-8; accommodation, C9 note); the IV-8 'inactive status period' (personal medical leave beyond 12 weeks up to 26 weeks with no right to reinstatement: not job-protected; noted on c3); pretenure extension I.G.5 (unusual constraints in the University: not for a parent's circumstances).

Modified Workload Policy (c13) is for a primary caregiver of a child 'who requires care beyond basic parenting' or of another family member; it does not cover basic care of a newborn and carries a pay cut, so it counts in no figure.
Calendar: the PPL equates sixteen weeks with a semester; term_weeks 16 recorded.
